title: Find the names of cards that are legal in the Legacy format, available only
question: Find the names of cards that are legal in the Legacy format, available only in paper, and belong to sets whose names contain 'Hero''s Path'. Among these, return only those with the highest converted mana cost within their respective sets.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T3."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_004" = 'paper'
  AND T2."XCL_110" LIKE '%Hero''s Path%'
  AND T1."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(T4."XCL_011")
      FROM cards AS T4
      INNER JOIN sets AS T5 ON T4."XCL_063" = T5."XCL_099"
      INNER JOIN legalities AS T6 ON T4."XCL_072" = T6."XCL_086"
      WHERE T6."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
        AND T6."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
        AND T4."XCL_004" = 'paper'
        AND T5."XCL_110" LIKE '%Hero''s Path%'
        AND T5."XCL_099" = T2."XCL_099"
  )

      INNER JOIN sets AS T5 ON T4."XCL_063" = T5."XCL_099"
      INNER JOIN legalities AS T6 ON T4."XCL_072" = T6."XCL_086"
      WHERE T6."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
        AND T6."XCL_085" = 'Legal'

        AND T5."XCL_110" LIKE '%Hero''s Path%'
